steps.title: Initialize Feature Requirements
steps.description: Analyze project configuration and prepare layout/code changes for loader, sound, and animation features.

steps.title: Update Layout with Loader & Main Views
steps.description: Modify activity_main.xml to declare the custom loading view container and interactive welcome container with a premium dark look.

steps.title: Implement Dynamic Sound Generator
steps.description: Write a dynamic PCM retro audio synth method in MainActivity.java to play musical chime tones using the standard AudioTrack APIs without assets.

steps.title: Design Custom View Animations
steps.description: Develop smooth scale-up, spring bounce, and fade animation routines programmatically in MainActivity.java using Android's ViewPropertyAnimator API.

steps.title: Structure Application Main Loop and Simulators
steps.description: Create timer simulations in MainActivity.java to transition from loading screen onto interactive screen after synthesized initialization completes.

steps.title: Configure Replay Trigger Interactions
steps.description: Establish click event handlers in MainActivity.java to reverse, reload, and trigger custom layout animations and sound synthesis.

steps.title: Verify Manifest and Package Specifications
steps.description: Verify XML schema declarations, and validate namespace configurations in AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Review Gradle Build Profile parameters
steps.description: Confirm application compile configurations, min SDK versions, compilation profiles, and packaging instructions.

steps.title: Confirm Application Metadata Specifications
steps.description: Ensure the system app-meta.json configurations match the designated app name and namespace properties exactly.

steps.title: Building Hello App
steps.description: Run high-level compiler processes to assemble, package, and generate executable packages containing animated assets.
